*  AOL Instant Messenger allows you to communicate instantly with any of your friends, family, or co-workers when they are online.
* From home or work, you can stay in immediate contact with anyone using AOL or AOL Instant Messenger.

190.title: AOL Instant Messenger Overview - Buddy List

controls.text: *  Group them in categories so you can immediately see when your work colleagues, family members, or sports buddies are available.
*  AIM is easy to use.  Simply create a list of online friends and you're ready to go.
*  You can see when they come online and chat with them privately.

191.title: AOL Instant Messenger Overview - Buddy Privacy

controls.text: Privacy is very important on the Internet.  With AIM, you control your level of privacy:
* You control who can see when you're online and who can send you instant messages.
* You control whether others can find you by your e-mail address.
* You control whether others can find you by your AIM personality/identity.
* You can even control whether others know when you're idle.
Your ability to control your privacy level allows you to communicate with anybody in the AOL Instant Messenger community or just a small group of friends.

192.title: AOL Instant Messenger Overview - Neighborhood Watch (SM)

controls.text: As a member of the AOL Instant Messenger community you help regulate it.
If people send you annoying or offensive messages, you can send them a warning.
Warnings are visible to others so they can alert people to potential troublemakers.  If enough warnings are imposed on someone, that person can be bumped off the service temporarily.
* Always use caution when communicating with people you don't know.  Never reveal your password!

193.title: AOL Instant Messenger Overview - My Profile

controls.text: You can establish your AIM personality easily with the Create My Personality Wizard.  It's important to define your AIM personality so that your friends can easily find you.
Your AIM personality can also allow others who share your same interests to find you for casual chatting.
Of course, as with other aspects of AIM, you control what parts of your AIM personality can be seen by others.

194.title: Set Up AOL Instant Messenger Now!

controls.text: Congratulations!  You have completed the AOL Instant Messenger Overview.  If you would like to set up your Buddy List, Buddy Privacy, or AIM Personality now, click on that button below.
Welcome to the AOL Instant Messenger community and have fun!

195.title: Create a Profile - Directory Profile Tips

controls.text: A Directory profile provides a way for people to find you by searching for you.  The first part of your Directory profile is simply used to allow friends, family and colleagues to find you by name and address.

If you like to chat with people online that have similar interests as you do, including some keywords or phrases which describe those interests in your Directory Profile is a great way to get started.
Think about what you like to do, discuss, or participate in with regard to...
*hobbies *sports *clubs or organizations *your education or profession *entertainment *home, family, religion *news && politics *community && lifestyle

196.title: Create a Profile - More Info Profile Tips

controls.text: The More Info area is a great place to provide more detailed and customized information about your likes, dislikes, provide links to your favorite Web hangouts, and describe yourself in a way which expresses your true personality.  Remember to:
* Include a link to your home page and favorite web site
* Take advantage of the toolbar provided which lets you use cool fonts and colors
Your Directory entry can also contain up to five areas of interest.  These areas can include hobbies, interests, profession, etc.  These entries let people find you for random chat.
You can add more detailed information about yourself and your areas of interest, including links to your e-mail address and web sites.
